This role combines business systems analysis, application development, data analytics, and technical leadership to ensure critical energy billing and settlement solutions remain accurate, reliable, scalable, and audit-ready. The Senior Energy Systems Analyst designs, develops, supports, and improves solutions using Excel/VBA, SQL, Microsoft Power Platform, and other appropriate technologies while partnering with Energy Settlements, Data Systems, System Operations, and other stakeholders. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced systems analyst who enjoys solving complex business problems, translating contracts and policies into dependable automated solutions, and driving continuous improvement across mission-critical utility processes. You will: Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain applications and automated solutions for energy billing, settlements, contract calculations, and reporting. Develop and support solutions using Excel/VBA, SQL, Microsoft Power Platform, and other appropriate technologies. Partner with Data Systems on database design, data integration, transfer processing, security, and web-based reporting. Engage users to validate requirements, usability, business controls, data quality, and solution performance. Support recurring billing and settlement activities for OPC, GTC, and Member Systems. Maintain supporting data, applications, calculation logic, and business rules while investigating exceptions and discrepancies. Coordinate issue resolution and deliver accurate billing data according to established schedules. Apply disciplined validation and control processes to reduce the risk of billing errors and protect data integrity. Translate contracts, policies, operational changes, and stakeholder needs into clear functional and technical requirements. Analyze complex data, identify trends and exceptions, and recommend improvements to automation, controls, reporting, and workflow. Apply forecasting, statistical analysis, and other advanced analytical methods, as appropriate, to support operational and strategic decisions. Represent the department in cross-company discussions regarding policy, contract, system, and process changes. Calculate and gather data supporting Control Area Compact bills and other critical contracts, resolve audit-related questions, and respond to Member and management data requests. Provide technical support, training, knowledge transfer, and work review for department applications and processes. Develop and maintain system documentation, business rules, process libraries, validation procedures, and reference guides. Mentor less-experienced analysts and provide feedback to department leadership without exercising direct supervisory authority. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field from an accredited college or university. A combination of relevant education, training, and directly related experience may be considered. Ideally, 4+ years of progressively responsible experience developing, supporting, or using complex energy billing, settlement, business-system, or comparable data-processing applications. Advanced Excel skills, including development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of VBA-based applications and automated processes. Experience translating business rules or contracts into data, calculation, reporting, and system requirements. Proficiency with SQL and relational data concepts. Experience with application design, integration, testing, implementation, support, change control, quality assurance, and business-process improvement. Ability to interpret complex contracts, policies, tariffs, procedures, and business rules and translate them into accurate technical requirements and acceptance criteria. Knowledge of data governance, access controls, program security, validation, reconciliation, audit support, and documentation practices. Ability to communicate technical and business information clearly to Members, management, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Utility Systems & Settlements Experience Moderate electric utility, generation and transmission, cooperative, energy-market, complex contract-billing, or energy-settlement experience. Experience supporting system and processes that manage high-volume billing, settlement, reconciliation, or contract-calculation processes in a controlled environment. Experience providing functional ownership, technical guidance, work review, or knowledge transfer for business-critical applications. Development, Data & Automation Experience with Microsoft Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Azure services, or comparable analytics and automation platforms. Experience with Python, R, or another object-oriented or scripting language. Experience modernizing legacy spreadsheets, automating manual workflows, strengthening controls, and improving user experience. You'll collaborate with systems, data, operations, and business stakeholders in a mission-driven environment focused on accuracy, reliability, strong controls, stakeholder service, and continuous improvement. Apply Today If you're ready to apply your systems analysis, application development, data, and process-improvement expertise to mission-critical utility solutions, we encourage you to apply.
